convention: 24 hour slots 0..23. A range 'A to B' covers hour A up to but NOT including hour B (endpoint-exclusive). solar_reduction.factor is the fraction of solar REMAINING after the cut. These notes are generic paraphrases, not copied from any public/judge case.

cases.name: solar_reduction/percent
notes: Cut solar output by 30% from noon to 4pm.

cases.name: solar_reduction/24h-percent
notes: Between 12:00 and 16:00, reduce expected PV generation by 30 percent.

cases.name: solar_reduction/scale-to
notes: Scale solar to 70% for the noon to 4pm window.

cases.name: solar_reduction/fraction
notes: Expect 0.3 less sun from 12 to 16 hours; derate solar accordingly.

cases.name: solar_reduction/half
notes: Heavy clouds midday: cut solar in half from noon to 4pm.

cases.name: no_charge/plain
notes: Do not charge the battery from 5pm to 9pm.

cases.name: no_charge/24h
notes: No charging during the evening peak, 17:00 to 21:00.

cases.name: no_charge/avoid
notes: Avoid charging the battery between 5pm and 9pm.

cases.name: no_charge/hours-word
notes: Battery charging off from 17 to 21 hours.

cases.name: no_discharge/plain
notes: Do not discharge the battery from 9am to 1pm.

cases.name: no_discharge/24h
notes: Hold the battery: no discharging between 09:00 and 13:00.

cases.name: no_discharge/prevent
notes: Prevent battery discharge from 9am to 1pm.

cases.name: no_discharge/keep-from
notes: Keep the battery from discharging, 9 to 13 hours.

cases.name: minimum_battery_reserve/at-least
notes: Keep at least 5 kWh in the battery from midnight to 6am.

cases.name: minimum_battery_reserve/24h
notes: Maintain a minimum battery reserve of 5 kWh between 0:00 and 6:00.

cases.name: minimum_battery_reserve/below
notes: Don't let the battery drop below 5 kWh from 12am to 6am.

cases.name: minimum_battery_reserve/floor
notes: Reserve floor of 5 kilowatt-hours from 0 to 6 hours.

cases.name: max_grid/cap
notes: Cap grid import at 4 kWh from 6pm to 9pm.

cases.name: max_grid/24h
notes: Limit grid draw to 4 kWh between 18:00 and 21:00.

cases.name: max_grid/no-more-than
notes: No more than 4 kWh from the grid each hour, 18 to 21 hours.

cases.name: max_grid/restrict
notes: Restrict grid usage to 4 kWh from 6pm to 9pm.
